nodes.text:
The early bird catches the worm.

Actions speak louder than words.

Yes, using Computer Control is the goal of the Ballistic app, but that part isn't built yet. The app repo says so:  - **The Computer Control code isn't written.** The two pieces that would read other apps' screens and tap or type in them, `ComputerControlScreen` and `ComputerControlHands`, are planned in `apps/assistant/README.md:280`. Neither exists yet. - **The current app has no way to act inside other apps.** Its action code, `IntentHands.kt:41`, can open an app and wait. Every tap, swipe or typing request returns "needs Computer Control". - **The app can't hold the permission yet, even on the patched OS.** Only an app built into the image as a system app can get the permission. Ballistic is installed as a normal app. `docs/PLATFORM.md` says this, and that the privileged app integration is not done. - **The agent that operates apps runs in the emulator harness,** using emulator input. It doesn't go through Computer Control. - **The OS patches haven't been tested on the phone either.** ballistic-os's validation record lists on-device Computer Control validation as pending.
